description: This Java class represents a 'Keyword' entity, used to associate keywords with products in various languages within the admin section of the shop management system. It includes fields for product ID, language code, and keyword, with appropriate getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Keyword
classes.description: A Java class representing a product keyword associated with a specific language and product ID, used in the admin catalog management functions.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with this keyword.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with this keyword.

methods.name: setLanguageCode
methods.description: Sets the language code for this keyword.

methods.name: getLanguageCode
methods.description: Returns the language code for this keyword.
